title: rosa woodsii var. glabrata
intro: Rosa woodsii var. glabrata, commonly known as the Smooth-leaved Wood's Rose, is a variety of the Wood's Rose plant native to North America. The Smooth-leaved Wood's Rose is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in herbal remedies to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, anxiety, and digestive issues, due to its therapeutic actions of reducing pain and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Rosa woodsii var. glabrata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the health benefits and therapeutic actions of the Smooth-leaved Wood's Rose.
